messages.content:
The failing test `testOptionGroupLong()` in `GnuParserTest` is trying to test the selection of an option from an `OptionGroup` with long options. The test creates an `OptionGroup`, adds two options with long names "foo" and "bar", adds the group to an `Options` object, parses the command line with the parser, and then asserts that the selected option in the group is "bar".

The current bug report states that the `OptionGroup.setSelected(Option option)` method does not work correctly when the selected option has a long name and no short name. Specifically, if the selected option does not have a short name, calling `group.setSelected(option)` has no effect.

Looking at the implementation of `OptionGroup.setSelected(Option option)`, we see that if the selected option is null, it resets the previously selected option. If an option is selected and it's the same option being reselected, it sets the selected option. However, if a different option is being selected, it throws an `AlreadySelectedException`.

The issue in the test may be related to how the long options are created using `OptionBuilder` in the test code. The `OptionBuilder.create(String opt)` method is responsible for creating an `Option` with the specified long name. This method sets the long name and other properties of the option, but it does not set a short name for the option.

Based on the description of the bug and the test code, the likely cause of the failure is that the selected option "bar" in the test does not have a short name associated with it. As a result, when `group.setSelected(option)` is called with the "bar" option, it may not be properly recognized as the selected option due to the absence of a short name.

To fix this issue, the `OptionBuilder` should be used to create options with both long and short names, ensuring that the selected option in the test has a short name associated with it.

Next, I will provide the methods that need to be fixed based on this analysis.
```
org.apache.commons.cli.OptionBuilder.create(java.lang.String)
org.apache.commons.cli.OptionGroup.setSelected(org.apache.commons.cli.Option)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
